title: Retries with exponential backoff and jitter

kcs.statement: Exponential backoff doubles the wait between retries (for example 100 ms, 200 ms, 400 ms) up to a cap, giving a struggling dependency time to recover.
Jitter randomises each backoff delay (for example uniformly between 0 and the computed delay) so clients that failed together do not retry in synchronised waves.
Retry only transient errors (timeouts, 503, 429) and only idempotent operations or calls carrying an idempotency key, with a cap on attempts so retries do not become a retry storm.
